environment: Disposable Linux ARM64 VM, 1 CPU, 2 GiB RAM; real Git and filesystem
result: Actual extracted capture code with real Git accepted untracked regular 0644 and 0755 files; refused symlink traversal, 4644, 2644, 1644, tracked and ignored files. It also exercised no-follow metadata, FIFO classification, parent checks, directory creation and chmod.
negativeControls: Changing U back to O caused the fixture to fail on a special-bit file. The old compiler/runtime without U refused with :fs2/refused stage 8 and exit 126.
limits: The compiler is a byte-patched test copy, not a released or self-built compiler. This extracted-source fixture is not end-to-end GitHub capture or restore, does not test concurrent writers, and is not Darwin or production qualification.
